headline: Cortex Network Scanner is now supported for FedRAMP; Finland added to the regional IP allowlists
summary_md:
- **Cortex Network Scanner** flipped from *not* supported to supported for FedRAMP customers, in both places the page says so.
- A **Finland (FI)** region was added to four allowlist tables — engine outbound, inbound sources, regional egress and the syslog receiver — so firewall rules need updating.
- **Prisma Access Browser** gained a parent page and its ingestion topic moved one level deeper, taking the XSIAM book from 2,271 to 2,272 pages.
- Several connector descriptions that still said **Cortex XSOAR** now say **Cortex XSIAM**, and two links that pointed at a `file:///` path or an opaque portal id were made relative.
- The rest is markup: allowlist tables re-emitted as raw HTML, notes converted to GitBook hint blocks, and console names bolded.

highlights.title: Cortex Network Scanner is now supported for FedRAMP customers
highlights.detail: Both occurrences of "is not supported" became "is supported". A reversal, not a clarification.

highlights.title: A Finland (FI) region was added across four IP allowlist tables
highlights.detail: New addresses appear for engine outbound, inbound sources, regional egress and syslog forwarding; the Broker VM column on the regional egress row was left blank and the inbound page labels the region "Finland (F)".

highlights.title: The Prisma Access Browser ingestion page moved under a new parent
highlights.detail: A near-empty Prisma Access Browser page was added and the ingestion topic relocated beneath it unchanged, so the old URL breaks.

highlights.title: Policy Audit Scan added Debian and Ubuntu benchmarks
highlights.detail: The supported list grew from the two CIS Windows benchmarks to also cover Debian and Ubuntu.

highlights.title: Two references were repointed at pages a reader can reach
highlights.detail: The API security link was a local `file:///` path and the Defender for Endpoint prerequisite pointed at an opaque docs-cortex resource id; both are now relative portal paths.

highlights.title: The Azure Event Hub procedure lost its step numbering
highlights.detail: Reflowing the diagnostic-settings section left lettered steps "c." and "d." inside a numbered list and renumbered the final Cortex XSIAM step from 6 to 4.

items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: FedRAMP support reversed to supported in both notices, and Policy Audit Scan now also covers Debian and Ubuntu alongside the CIS Windows benchmarks.
items.xsiam/onboard-cortex-xsiam/deployment-st: Adds Finland (FI) with five of six addresses; the Broker VM column is empty. Both region tables and the service table became HTML.
Adds Finland (FI) engine outbound addresses 35.228.175.228 and 35.228.44.44.
Adds an inbound row for the new region, labelled "Finland (F)" rather than (FI).
items.xsiam/onboard-cortex-xsiam/post-deployme: Adds Finland (FI) syslog forwarding addresses 34.88.235.28 and 34.88.248.229.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: New page, currently a heading only, inserted as the parent of the Prisma Access Browser ingestion topic.
Moved here unchanged from the palo-alto-networks-integrations root; the previous path no longer resolves.
items.xsiam/onboard-cortex-xsiam/deployment-st: The full FQDN, IP and App-ID allowlist table was re-emitted as one HTML table; no FQDN or port was added or removed.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Notes became GitBook hint blocks and console names were bolded, but the diagnostic-settings steps are now mis-numbered.
The inline base64 Falcon logo became a hosted image, and the two API-client screenshots were dropped from the procedure.
Gains a row describing the Workday content pack for tenants onboarded before July 26, 2026.
The table's first column header changed from "Forcepoint DLP vendor" to "Collection Method".
The Strata Logging Service connector is described as an XSIAM connector rather than an XSOAR one, in both the intro and the sub-capability list.
The API security link was a local file:/// path and now resolves to the cloud-security API landscape page.
The Enable access to required PANW resources prerequisite now uses a relative path instead of an opaque docs-cortex resource id.
